text: SPIDER-003: core/maintenance.py _pg_tables() calls has_table(t.name) without schema, so spider_fetches (schema cache) is left out of the PostgreSQL size in 'spider db info' and 'db vacuum'. Fix: pass schema=t.schema.

SPIDER-003: describe --json (x-rb-data) knows only user_data_dir, and x-rb-env lists only db.ENV_VARS (purpose database). The page storage files live in the user cache dir (SPIDER_CACHE_DIR) and its env SPIDER_CACHE_DIR / SPIDER_CACHE_TTL_DAYS / SPIDER_CACHE_MAX_GB are not published. A cache-dir entry and a non-database env purpose need a Standard change (cli-generator).
